recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. It completes the accepted display/description portion of FHIR-32577 without changing binding strength or value-set membership; any future changes to Composition.category wording or category value-set contents should be handled by separate OO/SD decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-32577 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked that DocumentReference.category's example binding reflect media, documents, and other referenced content by renaming document-classcodes to referenced-item-category and changing the short display to "Categorization of referenced record".
initial_application: Prior commits broadened and renamed the value set: cebeac615e0c434ff755a1aa763781d2cf61c8c2 added media-category and LOINC DOC filtering, and 1e542148c2d27a0394c2798fa8a1a78014db1b4d renamed the value set and changed the DocumentReference.category binding URL/name. The requested short display and related local descriptions still said document.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, and the referenced-item-category value set is used by the active category element. FHIR-24671 later supports the same value-set family by treating the value-set content as already applied and noting DocumentReference categories are broader than Composition categories. OO Confluence minutes confirm the FHIR-32577 block-vote approval; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed DocumentReference.category's short and binding description, the DocumentReference category SearchParameter description, the referenced-item-category ValueSet description, and the Event mapping exception companion source to use referenced-record wording. Historical release files and generated-looking diagrams were intentionally left untouched.
